decision.reasoning_trace: During the shopping session, I filtered out several products that were actually accessories (charging cables, replacement batteries, and carrying cases) or niche items like audio glasses and battery bases for smart displays. I focused on standalone portable speakers. My consideration set included the JBL Charge 5 for its top-tier reputation, the B&O Beosound A1 for premium audio quality, and several high-value budget options like Raymate and EDUPLINK. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because its 4.8-star rating over 16,000 reviews demonstrates exceptional reliability and sound quality, and its IP67 rating plus USB charging out feature makes it the most versatile and durable choice for outdoor and indoor use.
